2026 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 
04 - 06 September 2026 
  
 
From :  The FIA Formula 1 Technical Delegate  
To :  The Stewards Date :  04 September 2026 
  
 
Technical Delegate’s Report 
 
 
The following drivers will start the thirteenth Competition of the 2026 Formula One World 
Championship with a new internal combustion engine (ICE): 
 
Number Car Driver Previously used ICE 
    
81 McLaren Mercedes Oscar Piastri 3 
01 McLaren Mercedes Lando Norris 3 
12 Mercedes Kimi Antonelli 4 
16 Ferrari Charles Leclerc 3 
44 Ferrari Lewis Hamilton 3 
23 Atlassian Williams Mercedes Alexander Albon 4 
55 Atlassian Williams Mercedes Carlos Sainz 3 
87 Haas Ferrari Oliver Bearman 3 
05 Audi Gabriel Bortoleto 2 
10 Alpine Mercedes Pierre Gasl y 3 
43 Alpine Mercedes Franco Colapinto 3 
 
The internal combustion engine used by Kimi Antonelli and Alexander Albon is the fifth (5th) of 
the four (4) new internal combustion engines allowed for the 2026 Championship season and 
this is not in conformity with B8.2.2 a) of the 2026 Formula One Sporting Regulations. 
 
The internal combustion engine used by the rest of the above listed drivers is one (1) of the four 
(4) new internal combustion engines allowed for the 2026 Championship season and this is in 
conformity with B8.2.2 a) of the 2026 Formula One Sporting Regulations. 
 
 
The following drivers will start the thirteenth Competition of the 2026 Formula One World 
Championship with a new turbocharger (TC): 
 
Number Car Driver Previously used TC 
    
16 Ferrari Charles Leclerc 3 
44 Ferrari Lewis Hamilton 3 
55 Atlassian Williams Mercedes Carlos Sainz 3 
87 Haas Ferrari  Oliver Bearman 3 
05 Audi Gabriel Bortoleto 2 
 

The turbocharger used by the above drivers is one (1) of the four (4) new turbochargers allowed 
for the 2026 Championship season and this is in conformity with B8.2.2 b) of the 2026 Formula 
One Sporting Regulations. 
 
 
The following drivers will start the thirteenth Competition of the 2026 Formula One World 
Championship with a new exhaust set (EXH): 
 
Number Car Driver Previously used EXH 
    
81 McLaren Mercedes Oscar Piastri 2 
16 Ferrari Charles Leclerc 3 
44 Ferrari Lewis Hamilton 3 
31 Haas Ferrari  Esteban Ocon 2 
87 Haas Ferrari  Oliver Bearman 3 
05 Audi Gabriel Bortoleto 2 
 
The exhaust set used by the above drivers is one (1) of the four (4) new exhaust sets allowed 
for the 2026 Championship season and this is in conformity with B8.2.2 c) of the 2026 Formula 
One Sporting Regulations. 
 
 
The following driver will start the thirteenth Competition of the 2026 Formula One World 
Championship with a new motor generator unit-kinetic (MGU-K): 
 
Number Car Driver Previously used MGU-K 
    
63 Mercedes Geor ge Russell 2 
 
The motor generator unit-kinetic used by George Russell is one (1) of the three (3) new motor 
generator units-kinetic allowed for the 2026 Championship season and this is in conformity with 
B8.2.2 f) of the 2026 Formula One Sporting Regulations. 
 
 
The following drivers will start the thirteenth Competition of the 2026 Formula One World 
Championship with a new energy store unit (ES): 
 
Number Car Driver Previously used ES 
    
12 Mercedes Kimi Antonelli 3 
03 Red Bull Racin g RB Ford Max Verstappen 2 
05 Audi Gabriel Bortoleto 2 
 
The energy store unit used by Kimi Antonelli is the fourth (4th) of the three (3) new energy store 
units allowed for the 2026 Championship season and this is not in conformity with B8.2.2 d) of 
the 2026 Formula One Sporting Regulations. 
 
The energy store unit used by the rest of the above listed drivers is one (1) of the three (3) new 
energy store units allowed for the 2026 Championship season and this is in conformity with 
B8.2.2 d) of the 2026 Formula One Sporting Regulations. 
 
 
The following drivers will start the thirteenth Competition of the 2026 Formula One World 
Championship with a new control electronics unit (PU-CE): 
 
Number Car Driver Previously used PU-CE 
    
12 Mercedes Kimi Antonelli 3 
03 Red Bull Racin g RB Ford Max Verstappen 2 
23 Atlassian Williams Mercedes Alexander Albon 3 
 
The control electronics unit used by Kimi Antonelli and Alexander Albon is the fourth (4th) of the 
three (3) new control electronics units allowed for the 2026 Championship season and this is 
not in conformity with B8.2.2 e) of the 2026 Formula One Sporting Regulations. 
 
The control electronics unit used by Max Verstappen is one (1) of the three (3) new control 
electronics units allowed for the 2026 Championship season and this is in conformity with 
B8.2.2 e) of the 2026 Formula One Sporting Regulations. 
 
 
The following drivers will start the thirteenth Competition of the 2026 Formula One World 
Championship with a new power unit ancillary component (PU-ANC): 
 
Number Car Driver Previously used PU-ANC 
    
81 McLaren Mercedes Oscar Piastri 3 
03 Red Bull Racin g RB Ford Max Verstappen 3 
16 Ferrari Charles Leclerc 4 
44 Ferrari Lewis Hamilton 4 
23 Atlassian Williams Mercedes Alexander Albon 4 
22 Racing Bulls RB Ford Yuki Tsunoda 4 
87 Haas Ferrari  Oliver Bearman 3 
05 Audi Gabriel Bortoleto 4 
10 Alpine Mercedes Pierre Gasl y 4 
43 Alpine Mercedes Franco Colapinto 3 
 
The power unit ancillary component used by the above drivers is one (1) of the six (6) new 
power unit ancillary components allowed for the 2026 Championship season and this is in 
conformity with B8.2.2 g) of the 2026 Formula One Sporting Regulations.
